signature: HFONT WINAPI SYSLINK_SetFont(SYSLINK_INFO *infoPtr, HFONT hFont, BOOL bRedraw);

parameters.name: infoPtr
parameters.description: Pointer to the SysLink control instance state.

parameters.name: hFont
parameters.description: Handle to the new font, or NULL to draw text using the default system/GUI font.

parameters.name: bRedraw
parameters.description: TRUE if the control should redraw immediately after updating the font.

return_values.success: Previous HFONT stored in infoPtr->Font, with infoPtr->LinkFont populated as an underlined HFONT.

errors.condition: Returned when no previous font was assigned, while still creating a valid underlined LinkFont via HDC/stock font fallback.

edge_cases: When hFont is NULL or GetObjectW(hFont, sizeof(LOGFONTW), &lf) fails, SYSLINK_SetFont falls back through GetCurrentObject(hdc, OBJ_FONT), GetStockObject(DEFAULT_GUI_FONT), and GetStockObject(SYSTEM_FONT) before synthesizing a default Tahoma LOGFONTW so LinkFont creation never fails with 'err:syslink:SYSLINK_SetFont Failed to create link font!'.

On macOS Rosetta 2 (--full-x86), Universal (x86_64 + arm64) libfreetype.6.dylib is provisioned so x86_64-unix/win32u.so links HAVE_FREETYPE / SONAME_LIBFREETYPE and loads built-in tahoma.ttf and /System/Library/Fonts.
